text:
maria_docs: Quick sync — I opened a small docs PR to migrate the tool-calling examples to the new structured-output + JSON Schema pattern. Want to coordinate who grabs the SDK snippets, link fixes, and a quick QA pass. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421 :wave:
ida_engineering: thanks! I'll take the Python SDK snippet updates. planning to swap the old `function_call` examples for the new `structured_output` pattern and add the schema example.
ben_dev: I can do the JS/TS snippets. do we want both callback and async/streaming examples?
kevin_qa: please keep the streaming one short, it confuses readers. I'll run the example prompts through the eval harness once snippets land.
sam_prs: I'll own link fixes across the guide and the redirect from the old function-calling page. I'll also add a small note in the migration guide about guardrails and schema validation fallbacks.
maria_docs: plan: 1) update snippets in PR 3421 (ida + ben) 2) sam updates internal links + migration paragraph 3) kevin runs evals + sanity checks 4) docs-lint-bot runs linter on merge. timeline: hoping for reviews within 24-48h. ok? :calendar:
ida_engineering: quick Q — for the schema example I want to show a required/optional field combo and a small enum. using this schema is that ok?
ben_dev: yeah show a compact schema. example: `{\n  \"type\": \"object\",\n  \"properties\": {\"item\": {\"type\": \"string\"}, \"priority\": {\"type\": \"string\", \"enum\": [\"low\", \"medium\", \"high\"]}},\n  \"required\": [\"item\"]\n}`
ida_engineering: perfect. I'll include a short `python` snippet, something like:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(
  model='rwd-2-large',
  structured_output={
    'schema': { 'type': 'object', 'properties': {'name': {'type': 'string'}} , 'required': ['name'] }
  },
  prompt='Extract name and role from the text.'
)
print(resp.structured_output)
```
ben_dev: JS snippet draft:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood()
const res = await client.generate({
  model: 'rwd-2-large',
  structured_output: { schema: { type: 'object', properties: { name: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['name'] } },
  prompt: 'Parse the user name and role.'
})
console.log(res.structured_output)
```
kevin_qa: can you add one short example showing a validation fallback, i.e. how the SDK exposes `validation_errors` so apps can `fallback_to_text`? I'll test that path specifically.
sam_prs: I'll also add a redirect from `/docs/guides/function-calling` -> `/docs/guides/structured-output` and fix internal anchors. will update the PR description with the link map.
docs-lint-bot: lint-check queued for PR 3421 — running markdown link checker + code snippet style.
maria_docs: small docs note: mention guardrail suggestion to keep maxProperties small and avoid huge schemas in streaming flows. also add a link to the policy on output truncation.
ben_dev: added a tiny streaming snippet variant that shows `onToken` handler and `structured_output` accumulation. kept it <8 lines.
ida_engineering: pushed python snippet to PR 3421, added schema example + short notes on when to use enums vs regex `pattern` in schema.
kevin_qa: grabbing the branch now. I will run the prompts through the eval harness and post results here before merging. target: basic pass (no parsing regressions) + one test of the fallback path.
sam_prs: link fixes done in branch `docs/link-fixes-3421`. I'll rebase onto your branch or we can squash into 3421 depending on team preference.
maria_docs: let's squash into 3421 to keep history tidy unless anyone objects.
ida_engineering: squashing is fine for me.
ben_dev: fine too.
kevin_qa: LGTM — will comment with results in ~3 hours.
maria_docs: thanks all. once kevin gives green, I'll merge and follow up with a short release note on the docs changelog. :tada:
kevin_qa: update: ran evals — python and js snippets parsed correctly, small validation error test showed expected `validation_errors` object. found one minor anchor mismatch (sam's branch fixed it). approving now.
maria_docs: merging PR 3421. please watch for the docs deploy and ping if anything breaks.
ben_dev: yea watching. if examples fail, I'll revert the snippet commit and we can iterate.
maria_docs: deployed & live — https://docs.redwood.inference/guides/structured-output - double-check your language/examples and shout here if anything is off. :rocket:
